description:
Earn 17% promoting SkinAura whole-body deodorant cream.

SkinAura is a whole-body deodorant cream designed to help control body odor for up to 15 days after one application, when used as directed. Its aluminum-free formula comes in 24 individually sealed sachets per box—a compact format for home, travel and your gym bag.

Apply to clean, dry skin before bedtime and avoid washing the area for at least 8 hours. Reapply as needed. Individual results vary.

Customers shop directly on skinauralabs.com with free standard U.S. shipping. Product photos, caption starters and your personal affiliate link are available in your affiliate account.

  • Single — 24 sachets: $24.99 · about $4.25 commission.
  • Duo — 2 boxes: $44.99 · about $7.65 commission.
  • Value Pack — 3 boxes: $59.99 · about $10.20 commission.

Examples use current full prices. Discounts and returns reduce commission.

Start sharing: automatic approval after signup and email verification. Use your unique affiliate link; the referral window is 30 days.

Payout: 30-day hold from the order date, then manual review. Approved commissions are paid monthly by manual PayPal. Commission is 17% of eligible net product sales after discounts, excluding shipping, taxes, tips and refunded amounts. Subscription first order only. No additional customer discount. One payable affiliate commission per order across SkinAura programs.

View product photo — box and sachets · Full program terms

Use accurate product information and disclose your affiliate relationship. Contact: support@skinauralabs.com.
payout_period: Monthly by manual PayPal, after a 30-day hold from the order date and manual order review. Only approved, eligible commissions are payable.
term_and_condition:
SkinAura affiliates earn 17% commission on eligible product sales attributed to their affiliate link. Commission is calculated on the amount paid for products after all discounts, including subscription discounts, excluding shipping, taxes, shipping tax, tips, and refunded amounts.

The referral tracking window is 30 days after the affiliate link click. Both first purchases and separately placed repeat purchases may qualify. For subscriptions, commission applies only to the first subscription order; automatic renewals do not earn commission. The affiliate program does not provide an additional customer discount.

Commissions have a 30-day holding period from the order date and are manually reviewed before approval. Canceled and fully refunded orders do not earn payable commission. Partial refunds reduce commission proportionally. Unpaid, fraudulent, test, and chargeback orders do not earn payable commission. Orders with an unresolved payment, refund, or attribution issue remain under review until resolved.

Only one affiliate commission per order across all SkinAura affiliate programs is payable. Duplicate tracking records are reviewed against the Shopify order and referral evidence before approval and payment.

Approved commissions are paid monthly by manual PayPal payment, after the holding period and order review. Affiliates must provide valid PayPal payout details through their affiliate account. No automatic payment schedule is enabled in GoAffPro or UpPromote.

Use accurate product information and clearly disclose your affiliate relationship. Do not use spam, fraudulent orders, or manipulated tracking. Product information and purchase pages are available at https://skinauralabs.com. Program contact: support@skinauralabs.com.
